What is Aftercare?

Aftercare addiction treatment programs are treatment options that are available after inpatient treatment programs. These programs can be offered by the inpatient treatment provider, or by an outpatient treatment facility.

Aftercare treatment programs can include group therapy and individual therapy. You may have access to dual-diagnosis and medication-assisted treatment programs if you are living with another mental health concern.

What is the Benefit of Aftercare Treatment?

Aftercare treatment is a valuable resource for individuals who are in recovery. Inpatient treatment programs, including detox and rehab can help you develop skills necessary for a healthy recovery. Aftercare treatment programs can provide you with a safe and supportive place to come and process your challenges and triumphs.

Many individuals find that helping others benefits their recovery greatly. When you are in aftercare programs, you can share your hope and wisdom with others. This can occur in group sessions where you can provide validation and support for others in recovery.

What do Aftercare Programs Include?

Aftercare programs fall into the category of outpatient addiction treatment. Aftercare programs may have their own spin on their treatment; however, typical components of an aftercare program include group therapy, individual therapy, and possibly some educational sessions.

If you are living with another mental health concern, you can have access to dual-diagnosis care and medication-assisted treatment if this is appropriate for your recovery. Dual-diagnosis treatment is strongly recommended because for many, mental health concerns and addiction are often intertwined and can impact each other.

Aftercare programs in San Francisco can include a variety of treatment interventions that can provide you with support and encouragement as you progress through your recovery. Factors to Consider in Aftercare Programs?

When you find yourself ready to look into aftercare programs, there are a few components to be mindful of. The first of which would be that they can provide you with the proper treatment for your concerns. As an example, if you are living with another mental health concern, you should look for a program that can provide you with dual-diagnosis programming and medication-assisted treatment if necessary.

Aftercare programs fall into the outpatient treatment category, which means that you will be living at home, or in a sober home environment. You may be returning to work or school as well. Because of this, you will want to be mindful of the location of the treatment program and how your commute would fit into your routine. Some aftercare programs may offer sober housing options for individuals who do not have a safe or sober home environment.
In your search, it is important to consider access to unique treatment options that you would have access to. This can include meditation, yoga, mindfulness, and art therapy.
